"""Record of the original camera/depth-guided GR1 controller.

from pathlib import Path

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp
from rcb_client import Robot

BASE_T = np.array([2.69788, -2.14277, .90223])
BASE_R = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])

def world_to_base(position):
    return BASE_R.T @ (np.asarray(position) - BASE_T)

def deproject(depth, calibration, u, v):
    """Calibrated RGB-D pixel to observed world surface point."""
    k = np.asarray(calibration['intrinsic_cv'])
    m = np.asarray(calibration['cam2world_gl'])
    z = float(depth[int(v), int(u)])
    return (m @ [(u-k[0,2])*z/k[0,0], -(v-k[1,2])*z/k[1,1], -z, 1])[:3]

def interpolate(start, target, seconds, dt=.05, shortest_rotation=True):
    start, target = np.asarray(start), np.asarray(target)
    f = np.linspace(0, 1, int(round(seconds/dt))+1)[1:]
    actions = start + f[:,None]*(target-start)
    if shortest_rotation:

    return actions
